sn12.49:1.2: Na bhikkhave sutavato ariyasāvakassa evaṃ hoti || ||
sn12.49:1.4: kismiṃ sati kiṃ hoti || Kissuppādā kim uppajjati || ||
sn12.49:1.5: [Kismiṃ satī saṅkhāra honti || Kismiṃ sati viññāṇaṃ hoti ||] Kismiṃ sati nāmarūpaṃ hoti || kismiṃ sati saḷāyatanaṃ hoti || kismiṃ sati phasso hoti || kismiṃ sati vedanā hoti || kismiṃ sati taṇhā hoti || kismiṃ sati upādānaṃ hoti || kismiṃ sati bhavo hoti || kismiṃ sati jāti hoti || kismiṃ sati jarāmaraṇaṃ hotīti || || 3
sn12.49:2.1: Atha kho bhikkhave sutavato ariya sāvakassa aparapaccayā ñāṇam evettha hoti || ||
sn12.49:2.2: Imasmiṃ sati idaṃ hoti || imassuppādā idam uppajjati ||
sn12.49:3.1: Na bhikkhave sutavato ariyasāvakassa evaṃ hoti || ||
sn12.49:3.3: kismiṃ asati kiṃ na hoti || kissa nirodhā kiṃ nirujjhati ||
sn12.49:3.4: [Kismiṃ asati saṅkhārā na honti || kismiṃ asati viññāṇaṃ na hoti ||] kismiṃ asati nāmarūpaṃ na hoti || kismiṃ asati saḷāyatanaṃ na hoti || kismiṃ asati phasso na hoti || kismiṃ asati vedanā na hoti || kismiṃ asati taṇhā na hoti || kismiṃ asati upādānaṃ na hoti || kismiṃ asati bhavo na hoti || kismiṃ asati jāti na hoti || kismiṃ asati jarāmaraṇaṃ na hotīti || pe|| || 5
